section:
### Additional comparison

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 4. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 17.9 | 8.9 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 17.7 | 8.8 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.7 | 5.3 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 17.4 | 8.7 | 400 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
